# Hash-pinned pip for every workflow that installs Python packages.
#
# pip older than 26.2.2 always trusts its own vendored copy of the certifi CA bundle,
# so a runner's bundled pip can keep trusting a CA that certifi has since removed.
# Each job runs this first (pip --require-hashes --no-deps), before any other install:
#
#    python -m pip install --require-hashes --no-deps --requirement .github/pip-bootstrap-requirements.txt
#
# To update, change the version and take the digests from https://pypi.org/pypi/pip/<version>/json
# (the wheel and the sdist). Keep the pip pin in audit-requirements.txt in step with this file.
pip==26.2.2 \
    --hash=sha256:fd7f4dfa8190e014013b9f08f3e973f4e4c26ffd179a204895533a7254813a70 \
    --hash=sha256:3a8e5c800492787f33a4114ef54444546c340df428974ebba17e0fd47e11af2f
